content: अद्वैत {%a.%} [<sab>न˚ ब˚</sab>] .²1 Not dual; of one or uniform nature, equable, unchanging; ˚तं सुखदुःखयोः <ls>U. 1. 39</ls>. .²2 Matchless, peerless, sole, only, unique. .{@-तम्@} [<sab>न˚ त˚</sab>] .²1 Non-duality, identity; especially that of Brahman with the universe or with the soul, or of soul and matter; see अद्वय also. .²2 The supreme or highest truth or Brahman itself. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of an Upaniṣad; अद्वैतेन solely, without any duplicity.
